about.title: About your data
about.intro: At this stage Groscove Ultra does not read any real watch and does not collect data from your watch. The simulated watch is generated on the spot from the account and the date, and it is neither stored nor sent to anyone.
about.introAvailable: Groscove Ultra only reads a watch or ring after you connect it and authorize the categories, in Watches and rings. Below is an example of what a watch measures: none of it is yours.
about.rule: Today's rule: only what the watch measures on its own, through use — automatically or in a workout started on it. Nothing is typed.
about.modelHidden: What this model does not measure stays hidden in Today — it never shows as zero.
about.vendorTitle: What each brand does not share with other apps
about.vendorIntro: These numbers exist in the brand's app but are not shared with other apps. When it makes sense, we show our own calculation, always labelled.
about.regulatedTitle: Medical features the app does not read
about.regulatedIntro: These are regulated medical-device features. Groscove Ultra is for wellbeing and neither reads nor requests them.
about.onDemandTitle: Measurements that need an action from you (left out for now)
about.manualTitle: What never comes in, because it is typed, not measured
about.privacyBody: The old hydration and rest logs stayed only on this device; the new Today erased them from the browser without sending anything. Read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

real.syncHint: To update, sync the watch in the {app} app. There is no refresh button.
real.stale: Last sync: {date}, {time}. Sync in the {app} app to see new data.
real.aboutIntro: Groscove Ultra reads your {device} through the account you connected, only for the categories you authorized. The data is stored with its own protection, only you see it, and you can disconnect and delete it whenever you want.
real.manageBody: Disconnect, remove categories or your consent and delete the data in Watches and rings.

account.title: Account & privacy
account.description: Transparency about what the POC stores and how to delete your account.

demo.title: Demo nature
demo.body: Groscove Ultra is a public proof of concept. Subscriptions are simulated and orders are tests: there is no real payment, delivery or address.

store.title: What we store
store.item1: Full name, mobile number, email, display name, avatar (a photo you uploaded, if any), language, theme and time zone. The password generated at quick sign-up is stored encrypted; only you can see it, here.
store.item2: Interests, favorites, lists, progress, completions, streak, reminders and check marks.
store.item3: Simulated subscription (modules and periods) and test orders with a fictional destination.
store.item4: Usage events without personal data and optional feedback.
store.not: We do not collect real addresses, geolocation, payment data or individual health data.

retention.exceptions: Documented exceptions (legal evidence or incident) suspend anonymization while open.
